title: TeleMedic
tagline: Telemedic: A DApp enabling doctors to provide online consultations & host health seminars. Seamlessly connect with patients remotely, diagnose conditions, prescribe medications, & conduct virtual sessions.
description: Telemedic is a revolutionary decentralized application (DApp) that combines online consultations, health seminars, and secure medical data management. It empowers doctors to connect remotely with patients, utilizing video calls and secure messaging for diagnosis, treatment, and prescription services. By leveraging the LIT protocol, Telemedic ensures end-to-end encryption and security of patients' medical data. This decentralized approach enhances privacy, enables patients to maintain control over their records, and provides secure access for authorized healthcare professionals. Telemedic revolutionizes healthcare delivery by promoting convenience, accessibility, data security, and patient empowerment.
how_its_made:
Telemedic is a cutting-edge decentralized healthcare application that incorporates various technologies to provide a seamless and secure user experience. 

The foundation of Telemedic's crypto payment system is APECOIN, enabling patients to make secure and convenient cryptocurrency transactions for healthcare services. To store and manage Non-Fungible Token (NFT) data, Telemedic leverages NFT.Storage.  NFTS are used to token gate online webinars .

For live webinars and virtual appointments, Telemedic integrates Livepeer LiveKit and Huddle, respectively. Livepeer LiveKit enables smooth and high-quality video streaming, allowing healthcare professionals to conduct engaging live webinars for educational purposes. Huddle facilitates virtual appointments by providing a robust platform for doctors and patients to connect, communicate, and share medical information remotely.

To ensure the privacy and security of patient diagnostics, Telemedic utilizes the Lit Protocol. This protocol employs advanced encryption techniques, safeguarding sensitive medical data and allowing patients to have full control over their diagnostic information.

To streamline appointment management, Telemedic employs the Push protocol, which notifies doctors in real-time when they have appointments scheduled, ensuring efficient communication and timely responses.

The backend data store of Telemedic is powered by Polybase, providing a reliable and scalable solution for storing and retrieving healthcare data securely.

NextJS, a popular front-end framework, forms the foundation of Telemedic's user interface, enabling fast and interactive experiences for patients and healthcare professionals. Solidity, a programming language for smart contracts, is used to develop and deploy the smart contracts that govern the interactions and transactions within the Telemedic ecosystem.

Through the combination of these technologies, Telemedic offers a decentralized and secure healthcare platform that revolutionizes the way doctors and patients connect, share information, and access medical services.
